main_measure.name: pooled OLS slope of 5-bar excess return on forecast
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope > 0 with t >= 2 (and check passes); reject: slope < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 independent cases

supporting_check.name: mean excess 5-bar return of the 20% most negative-forecast cases below 0

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and 2 (inconclusive rule).
reading: Cases are all bars of each window's non-overlapping 5-bar grid (positions 0, 5, 10, ...) with a forward return, including forecast-0 bars; the 300 minimum is counted on these cases; the slope's t uses day-clustered (CR1) standard errors in an OLS with intercept; the deepest fifth is the ceil(20%) cases with the lowest forecast.
